controls.stopRules: A control failure halts; a stall gets one identical resubmission and a second consecutive stall halts; a quota pause resumes with a labeled resubmission.

timeouts.expectedOutput: the largest golden response, in local o200k_base tokens, over every eligible arm and instance of the family level
timeouts.formula: timeoutMs = ceil((baseMs + perTokenMs x expected output tokens) / roundToMs) x roundToMs
timeouts.rationale: At least the round-1 limit; 60 ms per token allows about 17 answer tokens per second beyond two minutes for reasoning and latency. Elapsed time is reported as a measure.

hashEncoding.artifacts: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes
hashEncoding.plan: SHA-256 of canonical sorted-key JSON of plan.json as the runner writes it
